name: S13
details: Capture the two section handles and movable subtree once outside timing. Before iteration i, move subtree to first section if even, second if odd. Set inactive section id=other; active section id=hit if even, unmatched if odd. Even target width is 17px; odd target width is initial auto. Common root-opacity mutation also applies. No mutation during resolution/callback.
common_mutation: Before each warmup/measured resolve, set document-element inline style to opacity:0.5 on even iteration and opacity:1 on odd iteration. Use one sequence spanning 5 warmup and 16 measured iterations; initial setup resolve excluded.
